title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF CITY PLANNING (DCP) relative to a Code Amendment to Chapter I and Chapter 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code as…
text:
[Council File 26-1247]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF CITY PLANNING (DCP) relative to a Code Amendment to Chapter I and Chapter 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code as instructed by Council, requesting DCP in coordination with the City Attorney to draft an ordinance that would keep the Zoning Code aligned with the amended Charter in the event that Ballot Measure “PL” is approved by the voters in the November 3, 2026 election. Ballot Measure “PL” proposes the establishment of a Neighborhood Appeals Commission that replaces Area Planning Commissions and establishes a process for City Council review of Neighborhood Appeals Commission and City Planning Commission decisions; changes the process for City Council action on certain planning decisions; and removes references to obsolete Charter Sections in the Zoning Code. The Amendments to the Los Angeles Municipal Code are exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to the California Public Resources Code Section 21080(b)(1) and CEQA Guidelines Sections 15320, 15378(b)(5), and 15061(b)(3); project findings.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Planning and Land Use Management Committee report to be submitted in Council. If a public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
